notes.title: Alpha 1.3 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[h2]CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Post processing changes.
[*] Grabbing items has been replaced with holding items.
[*] Items no longer collide with the player.
[*] You drop your held item when you die. (doesn’t apply to inventory)
[*] Moved to Universal Render Pipeline. (More flexible renderer)
[*] Wave animation when interacting with NPC’s.
[*] Changed sizes of some items.
[*] Player model.
[*] Player facecam in some dialogue moments.
[*] Death cam & ragdoll.
[*] NPC’s now have a ‘first time’ dialogue.
[*] Dialogue has been improved for most NPC’s.
[*] Some NPC’s have ambient/idle sounds.
[*] Slight Breach visual redesign.
[*] Breach AI improvements.
[*] Breach is faster.
[*] Moved Breach to a new area. (First left after the library)
[/list]

[h2]FIXES:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Player can no longer fly on items.
[*] Fixed map geometry in some areas.
[*] Epsilon now appears correctly in the pillar room.
[/list]
